stimuli.source: REBUILT from V1 web appendix PHT-6 (published: rating 99 / $35). Published phantom was superior on BOTH attributes vs. HD (rating 99 > 98 AND price $35 < $40), violating R1 requirement of exactly-one-attribute superiority. Rebuilt to be superior on EXACTLY ONE attribute: rating 99 > 98 (superior on quality, the target's strong attribute); price $40 = $40 (equal on price). Published values: rating 99, price $35.
flags: PHT_rebuilt_R1: published PHT-6 phantom ($35/99) was superior to HD ($40/98) on BOTH attributes (rating 99 > 98 AND price $35 < $40). This is an R1 violation (phantom must be superior on exactly one attribute). Rebuilt phantom: rating 99 (superior on quality), price $40 (equal to HD). Now superior on exactly one attribute (rating).
PHT_PUBLISHED_VALUES_RECORDED: published phantom was rating=99, price=$35 (V1 web appendix PHT-6). Rebuilt phantom uses rating=99, price=$40.
PHT_ONE_ATTRIBUTE_CONFIRMED: rebuilt phantom superior on rating only (99 > 98); equal on price ($40 = $40). R1 geometry requirement satisfied. available=false.

stimuli.source: REBUILT (V1 web appendix SOT-6 used old geometry: added a middle option at $25/82, making HD the top extreme; new plan requires two BIN options PLUS one NEW EXTREME beyond HD so former HD becomes the middle). New extreme: rating 100 / $65. Rating cap (100) reached; extended via higher price ($65 > $40) per geometry_constraints note, following the Hotels and Bluetooth-speakers precedent. Former HD (98/$40) is now geometrically the middle option on both attributes.
flags: SOT_GEOMETRY_REBUILT: V1 SOT-6 used old 'add a middle' geometry (Middle=$25/82, HD=$40/98 remained the top). New plan requires adding an extreme BEYOND HD so HD becomes the middle. Rebuilt with new extreme at rating 100 / $65.

RATING_CAP_APPLIED: rating attribute caps at 100; extreme extended via higher price ($65) rather than impossible rating (>100), following geometry_constraints and the Hotels and Bluetooth-speakers precedents.
SOT_MIDDLE_VERIFIED: HD (98/$40) is strictly between HF (65/$7) and EXTREME (100/$65) on both rating (65 < 98 < 100) and price ($7 < $40 < $65).
SOT_V1_MIDDLE_RECORDED: V1 SOT-6 middle was rating=82, price=$25 (Sharif et al. Study 3). Preserved in MOT menu tiers.

stimuli.source: CONSTRUCTED (no published analog for SIM in Sharif, Webb, and Bhatia 2025 or any V1 source). Clone is near-duplicate of HD: same price ($40), rating 99 vs HD's 98 (minimal upward step of 1 point). Clone is NOT dominated by anything: HD has equal price and lower rating (98 < 99), so HD does not dominate clone on quality. Clone is same is_hd=true as HD (premium, high-rating option).
flags: SIM_NO_PUBLISHED_ANALOG: no Sharif, Webb, and Bhatia 2025 or V1 stimulus exists for the similarity structure. Constructed minimally per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B) SIM geometry.

SIM_NON_DOMINANCE_CONFIRMED: clone (99/$40) is NOT dominated by HD (98/$40) because clone rating 99 > HD rating 98; clone is not dominated by HF (65/$7) because clone rating 99 >> 65 and clone price $40 > $7 (HF beats on price but not rating; no full dominance). Guard against Berkowitsch rounding accident: clone does not silently become a decoy because clone is strictly better than HD on the quality attribute.
SIM_CLONE_OF_HD: clone shares is_hd=true with HD; distance on rating is 1 point (minimal); price is identical ($40).
